description: See the picture without looking at it (and check what you see, as numbers). Open the page headless, let it run (after optional steps) and measure the frame with the scene's own renderer, by rendering with and without each object: mean luma and the share of near-black and near-white pixels, how much is background, and per object (named objects, or the meshes in them) the share of the frame it really shows, where it is (top left .. centre .. bottom right), whether the frame edge cuts it, how much of it is hidden and by which object. Verdicts name what is wrong (nothing visible, too dark, blown out, tiny, mostly hidden). `expect` claims are judged on the same numbers: "car visible >= 5%", "car in view", "car centered", "car not cut", "car not hidden", "frame not dark", "frame not bright", "background <= 70%". Use it after a change to the camera, lights, materials or layout, and for agents that cannot see pictures.

annotate.description: also return the frame with a numbered box and the name of each visible object (the same numbers as the text)

expect.description: claims: "car visible >= 5%", "car centered", "car not cut", "car not hidden", "frame not dark"

fixed_dt.description: deterministic clock: ms per frame (default 16.67); waits become frames

max_objects.description: objects to measure at most (default 40, the largest first)

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

seed.description: deterministic clock: seed for Math.random; the clock is paused and moves one fixed frame at a time, so every run gives the same frames and pixels

size.description: width of the measuring frame in pixels (default 160)

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

name: three_look
title: The frame as text: what is in view, how big, cut, hidden, too dark
